FICTIONAL MODEL ACT 2026

Article 12 — Licensing permits

1. “Applicant” means the natural or legal person named in the application.
2. The licensing authority shall grant the permit to an applicant who has filed a complete application and paid the fee, unless the authority establishes a serious risk to public safety.
3. The authority may grant a provisional permit while the safety review is pending.

This text is a synthetic semantic fixture. It is not legal authority.
